Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: Ok, so the only reason you should need to get a pellet grill is the flavor. If you're still using another type of grill, you're basically wasting your meat. Stop it. The flavor of everything we've cooked on this bad boy is on a different level. Now the reasons you should get a Traeger, specifically this newer line is the speed and the ease of use. This thing goes from ambient temps to 450 in about 6 or 7 minutes. Wow, from what I understand that has a lot to do with the newer D2 motor, I expected to have to wait forever for the grill to warm up, and have been pleasantly surprised that wasn't the case. The WiFIRE is the next reason you should get this grill, or another grill that includes that feature. Being able to check the temperatures of both the grill and the probe, as well as make adjustments from your phone is truly a game changer. You can even load recipes from the Traeger app to the grill and it will change the temps as needed for you! What a world. The quality of this thing is incredible, built like a tank, and the attention to detail paid creates a high level fit and finish that you wouldn't expect to see on a "grill". If you're in the market, good news, your search is over.
Results.Title: The flavor gods have smiled down on this grill!
